svg.title: The Wager, case 3
svg.desc: Case 3: a failed payment of ₹500, reason network error, 1 prior retry, customer for 8 months, 7 past payments succeeded, paid by card. Note on file, which the model cannot read: updated their card in the profile yesterday. Scoreboard: humans ±₹0, model +₹4,678; rounds won 0, tied 0, lost 1.
